frontMatter.title: Legionnaire
frontMatter.subtitle: Caffeine, Code, and Cyber Security, a 48 Hour AI-Powered SIEM Hackathon Project
frontMatter.description: Legionnaire is an AI-powered SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) platform designed for comprehensive, automated threat detection and response. It operates as a modular, GUI-less client running in the background, consisting of a client, a control-server and web dashboard. Our team built it in <48 Hours for the UQCS Hackathon 2025.
frontMatter.keywords: AI SIEM, XGBoost, Hackathon, Cyber Security, UQCS, Legionnaire, Python, React
